from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancingCashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """Captures financing cash flow data from a single financial statement filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company that filed this statement")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date or period the financial statement covers")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The full label of the line item (e.g., 'net cash used in financing activities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value reported for the line item")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    direction: str | None = Field(description="Whether the cash was provided by or used in financing activities")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_cash_flows: list[FinancingCashFlowRecord]
